reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS APP.

Terrible AI. No matter how clearly you explain the story, it constantly ignores your instructions and forces the main character into absolutely everything. Even when you want to spend time with friends or experience events without him, the AI keeps making everything revolve around him. It's repetitive, frustrating, and completely ruins the storytelling experience. It feels like the AI simply cannot follow basic instructions.

reviews.title: Characters.
reviews.text:
The characters are so dramatic. Whenever you try to cause a little drama with them they'll write out a whole paragraph and then  in the end it just ends off with them leaving out of wherever they're at. 
 It's like they try too hard to be sweet instead of playing into the role play. I do enjoy the app so that's why i'm typing out a Review instead of deleting the app. The bots also have horrible memory! I'll say something and then a couple chats later and i bring it up the bots act like i never said it and they also do it with their own chats. If the bots would just be more rude when it's necessary and actually try to put up a fight instead of playing into it once and then giving up it would be so much better. Thank you!

reviews.title: Ads
reviews.text: At the end of 30-60 sec ads, the majority of the time they will freeze at the end so you cannot exit the ad. Therefore you have no choice but to reload the app and unnecessarily rewatch another ad just to get the gems needed to chat. It happens alot for me and i know i am not the only one experiencing problems with rewards and ads because other reviews share the same problems. Also at the moments the ai seems to just waste the gems im forced to watch ads for by sending two blank messages in a row or just stuff like this “Continue directly from the last line of the latest message. Don't end on a question unless it's genuinely needed for the scene's flow and cut before it would be the protagonist's turn. No reflecting on the protagonist's feelings or summarizing anything from their perspective. No inventing new characters unless specified in lore.” Just random directions for the AI?? Its so frustrating especially when its costing gems to talk bs or nothing at all. Fix this

reviews.title: Horrible glitches
reviews.text: At first, I really did enjoy the app given that it was decently detailed and only a couple of adds periodically. As I began to use it more, I discovered way more glitches to the point where it wasn’t enjoyable. It would randomly start speaking in different languages and my messages from a while ago would randomly start sending again. And as I’d type it would randomly delete all the messages with no trace and go back to the messages from like an hour ago. It would randomly glitch where when I’d try to open the app it would say that I was logged out, but it usually automatically logged me back in after waiting for a couple of seconds. One day, it logged me out and wouldn’t let me log in so my account with all my chats and personas and gems is now gone.

reviews.title: Personality
reviews.text: I honestly loved this app so much when I first got it, like the adds don’t bother me much but since all the new updates every character acts the same! Like whenever I open a chat I might say something little like “oh hi ___ I’m __” and it will reply with something completely inappropriate talking about s*x or something like that. I get it’s an 18+ app but that dosent mean every chat has to be s*xual! It’s not fair bc that’s not even why I want the app. Idk if anyone else’s acts like that but it’s making me not want to use the app anymore. And when I tried the premium and ultra version that waste more gems ITS THE EXACT SAME! I don’t see the point in making us use more gems if nothing is actually going to be a noticeable change
